claude_proposed_widenings.name: move_self
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Forceful Blow grants voluntary self-movement toward the target tied to half the user's Speed. The current surface only supports forced movement of another creature or teleportation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can then move up to half your Speed straight toward the target without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
